statement.p: Calculate {\mathbf{T}}_u, {\mathbf{T}}_v, and \mathbf{n}(u,v) for the parametrized surface at the given point.
Then find the equation of the tangent plane to the surface at that point.

static.solution: {\mathbf{T} }_u =\frac{\partial \mathrm{\Phi }}{\partial u}=\frac{\partial }{\partial u}( 2u+v,u-4v,8 u )= \left\lt 2,1,8 \right>{\mathbf{T} }_v =\frac{\partial \mathrm{\Phi }}{\partial v}=\frac{\partial }{\partial v}( 2u+v,u-4v,8 u )= \left\lt 1,-4,0 \right> The normal is the cross product: \mathbf{n} ( u,v )={\mathbf{T} }_u \times {\mathbf{T} }_v = \left|\begin{array}{rrr}\mathbf{i} \amp \mathbf{j} \amp \mathbf{k} \\ 2\amp 1\amp 8\\ 1\amp -4\amp 0\end{array}\right|=\left|\begin{array}{rr}1\amp 8\\ -4\amp 0\end{array}\right|\mathbf{i} -\left|\begin{array}{rr}2\amp 8\\ 1\amp 0\end{array}\right|\mathbf{j} +\left|\begin{array}{cc}2\amp 1\\ 1\amp -4\end{array}\right|\mathbf{k} = 32 \mathbf{i} +8 \mathbf{j} -9 \mathbf{k} The equation of the plane passing through the point P:\mathrm{\Phi }( 4,9 )=(17,-32,32 ) with the normal vector \left\lt 32,8,-9 \right> is: \left\lt x-17,y + 32,z-32 \right>\cdot \left\lt 32,8,-9 \right> =0 or 32 x - 544+8 y + 256-9z+288=0 32 x + 8 y = 9 z
